description:
#mecha #revenge

He worked 2 jobs to support his "sick" wife, only to catch her marrying a billionaire! 😱

Watch what happens when his 5-year seal breaks and the Titan returns... 💥👇

Ethan Cross hid his identity and swept floors for five long years to protect his marriage. But on the day his seal was finally lifted, he found his wife, Ava, throwing a lavish engagement party with another man! 💔

She called their marriage a foolish bet and mocked his poor delivery job in front of elite society. But just as the guards were ordered to throw him out, IronCore's master fleet arrived at the hotel... 🔥🤖

#ShortDrama #AlphaMale #Revenge #Mecha #PlotTwist
